messages.author: 08a38a1b55af9c04
messages.subject: fitted values from colext?
parts:
Greetings,
Thanks for a great R package (unmarked) and a very helpful google
group!

I'm having trouble extracting fitted values from a colext model. I'd
like to use the fitted values in a parametric bootstrap to examine
goodness of fit (following the example on pg. 16 in the dynamic
occupancy model vignette).

When I run the following colext example code:

# Real data
data(frogs)
umf <- formatMult(masspcru)
obsCovs(umf) <- scale(obsCovs(umf))
## Use 1/4 of data just for run speed in example
umf <- umf[which((1:numSites(umf)) %% 4 == 0),]
## constant transition rates
(fm <- colext(psiformula = ~ 1,
gammaformula = ~ 1,
epsilonformula = ~ 1,
pformula = ~ JulianDate + I(JulianDate^2), umf, control =
list(trace=1, maxit=1e4)))
fitted(fm)

I get the following error message:

Error in .local(umf, ...) :
unused argument(s) (formlist = list(psiformula = ~1, gammaformula =
~1, epsilonformula = ~1, pformula = ~JulianDate + I(JulianDate^2)))

Any ideas what might be going wrong?
Thanks,
Steve

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] fitted values from colext?
parts:
This works for me. Perhaps your version of unmarked is old. The latest version is 0.9-1:

> packageVersion("unmarked")
[1] ‘0.9.1’



Richard
